title: 8 years apart, spot the difference: Gurgaon's annual infrastructure betrayal

Despite substantial infrastructure spending, the city faces recurring waterlogging issues. Civic body vacancies and a focus on symptoms hinder long-term resilience efforts. Changing rainfall patterns necessitate updated urban planning for future preparedness.

title: ‘Badly bruised’: Morkel reveals why Pant did not keep as Jurel took gloves

title: Vande Mataram row: Is Cong taking a calculated gamble or walking into BJP's trap?

Congress leaders defended their actions by invoking historical importance, while they criticized the BJP for politicizing the issue. This controversy underscores Congress's struggle to navigate its revival strategy amidst opposing pressures.

title: Elon Musk's first words to Cursor's 1,000 engineers named the company beating him

Musk said Grok is not the market leader and praised rival Anthropic. Cursor CEO Michael Truell now reports directly to Musk, staff are being folded into SpaceXAI teams, and 45 employees have left the company since April.

title: Colombo Test sees third ICC punishment as Jayasuriya joins Jaiswal, Fernando
content: Sri Lanka spinner Prabath Jayasuriya received an official reprimand and one demerit point. This sanction occurred after he breached the ICC Code of Conduct during the Colombo Test. Jayasuriya struck boundary wedges with his bat after being dismissed leg-before wicket. He joins Yashasvi Jaiswal and Asitha Fernando, who were also punished earlier. Three players have now been sanctioned in this ongoing Test match.

title: Zuckerberg’s wife Priscilla Chan’s $125m school to shut after 10 yrs

Funding from the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative ceased, prompting the board's unanimous decision to shut down. While offering extensive support services, the school's academic results did not meet state benchmarks. The Chan Zuckerberg Initiative is providing financial support for the transition and educational savings accounts.

title: 2nd Test: India struggle to finish off tail as Sonal, Pasindu lead Lanka resistance
content: Sri Lanka ended Day 3 at 265/8, resisting India’s bowlers through a determined lower-order fightback. Sonal Dinusha remained unbeaten on 85, while Pasindu Sooriyabandara scored 80. India had reduced Sri Lanka to 216/7 but failed to finish the innings. Dinusha’s partnerships with Keshara Nuwantha and Lahiru Kumara frustrated India, leaving Sri Lanka 38 runs short of avoiding the follow-on.

title: Microsoft's pay data leaks online, gives a rare look at compensation structure
content: An internal spreadsheet leak has shed light on Microsoft's compensation strategies, detailing employee base salaries, raises, cash bonuses, and stock awards at various levels. Notably, those in the Cloud and AI divisions enjoyed significantly higher compensation compared to teams in Azure and Security, which had more modest pay levels. This incident highlights the ongoing conversation around pay transparency in the context of talent retention.

title: China's Xi Jinping to visit India with 400-member delegation for Brics: Report

This diplomatic mission comes at a crucial time as India and China aim to mend their relationship following past border conflicts.

title: Happy Onam 2026: Best wishes, quotes & messages for family and friends

title: He was told India couldn’t send him to Mars: How did he build NoPo to prove it wrong?

In 2011, he co-founded Bengaluru-based NoPo Nanotechnologies after being told industrial production of the advanced material was “not possible” in India. Fifteen years later, NoPo is scaling up single-walled carbon nanotube production for potential applications in batteries, semiconductors, electronics and advanced materials, turning an ambitious space dream into a deep-tech manufacturing venture.

title: In 2022, Hunga Tonga sent water vapour into the stratosphere, altering ozone and radiation

This additional moisture led to an initial cooling effect on the stratosphere while also modifying circulation patterns. The presence of sulfate aerosols played a significant role in blocking sunlight, creating a stronger cooling influence.

title: Iran used mosques to surveil, shoot at January protesters: Report
content: security forces used mosques across Tehran as bases to deploy personnel, monitor protesters and confront demonstrators during a deadly crackdown in January . witnesses described security activity around the mosque after electricity was cut in the area, while surveillance drones flew overhead .

title: Vermont to expand Snake Mountain WMA and secure 949 acres of timber rights
content: the Vermont Fish & Wildlife Department plans to secure the timber rights covering 949 acres of the Snake Mountain Wildlife Management Area (WMA) the state also plans to acquire an additional 256 acres in Addison and Weybridge, expanding the popular natural area by nearly 25% .

title: BPSC exam row, 'dogs bark' remark: What has triggered fresh student protests in Bihar
content: BPSC protest intensifies as students breach barricades, govt says . students clashed with police during a massive protest over irregularities in the 70th exam . the protest was met with a heavy police deployment . police also used water cannons as protesters tried to push past the barricaded barricains .

title: 'Lake America': Trump floats plan to rename Lake Ontario amid US-Canada trade row
content: president Donald Trump said the united states is considering renaming Lake Ontario as Lake America . remark comes amid a growing war of words between Washington and Ottawa . the move followed by Trump's threatened 50% tariffs on about $20 billion worth of Canadian goods .

title: Florida’s Everglades face new threat from invasive eel worse than Burmese python
content: the Asian swamp eel spreads through wetlands and preys on fish, crayfish, frogs and other aquatic animals . the species is exceptionally difficult to control because it can survive periods of low water by burrowing into mud . some Everglades scientists warn its effects on the wetland food web could ultimately be more damaging than those of the notorious burmese python .

title: ‘We are under attack’: US military aircraft lands in Russia, sparks wild theories
content: the aircraft, operating as RCH4555, flew from Riga, Latvia, to Moscow . it departed Riga at 8:50am Moscow time and landed at Vnukovo shortly after 10am . a cameraman apparently joking, “we are under attack!” as the aircraft descended towards the airport .
